verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents a workflow for generating a Convertible Note (or Bridge Note). Its platform workflows generate documents to execute in-platform, with emailed review-and-sign links and drawn, uploaded or typed signatures. Completed documents link to the cap table, and scenario modeling covers hypothetical future rounds. However, nothing shows SAFEs or explicit modeling of conversion terms (cap, discount, conversion into a priced round) on the cap table. Missing for 10: SAFE instrument support, documented modeling of note/SAFE conversion terms on the cap table, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create, send, and e-sign SAFEs or convertible notes in-platform, and they land on the cap table with their conversion terms modeled
